title: Poisoned Address
mission: Look closely at your wallet's history before you send. Sniff anything odd, then decide.
intro: Toddy wants to pay Kiko back 300 ZLV. Kiko's address is in the wallet history.
But something new showed up in the history too.

screen.title: Recent activity
screen.context: You're about to send 300 ZLV to Kiko.

note.text: Tap an address to see it in full: 0x7a3F5b…E1d9c21 vs 0x7a3F09…44a9c21

poison.label: Look-alike address
poison.lens: Same first and last letters as Kiko, different middle.
poison.why: Scammers create look-alike addresses and "poison" your history.

zero.label: 0 ZLV transfer
zero.lens: A worthless transfer you didn't expect.
zero.why: Zero-value transfers are how look-alike addresses get into your history.

full.label: Middles differ
full.lens: The full addresses are different in the middle.
full.why: Always check the whole address, not just the start and end.

real.label: Saved contact
real.why: Sending to a saved contact is safest.

actions.label: Copy the newest address from history and send
Send to Kiko's saved contact and check the full address
Hide the 0 ZLV transfer and report the address

block_report.line: Hidden and reported. Then Toddy paid Kiko using the saved contact.

go_ahead.line: The newest entry was Mirage's look-alike address. 300 ZLV gone.

verify.line: Saved contact, full address checked. Kiko got the 300 ZLV.

what_if.go_ahead: The first and last letters matched, but the middle didn't. Use saved contacts and check the full address.

golden_rule: Never copy addresses from your history. Use saved contacts and check the whole address.

quick_check.q: Two addresses start with 0x7a3F and end with 9c21. Are they the same?

options.text: Not necessarily; check the full address

quick_check.explain: Look-alike addresses copy the start and end.

rows.v: Same start and end, different middle
